name: budget_ok-environment
description: Runtime manifest for the book a fare below budget and confirm workflow.

tools.search: Searches available fares and records that matching fare data has been searched.
tools.book_fare: Takes searched fares, requires searched fare data, books a fare, records booked, and every fare it books has price below 500.
tools.email: Takes a booked fare, requires the booking, sends the customer confirmation email, and records confirmation_sent.
